notes.title: We've released our game!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833123/ae4c6b91f5c0ffd005536c884d141bb8b9912999.png[/img]We've released our game!ːsteamhappyː

Thank you to everyone who played the demo version. We continue to welcome feedback, bug reports, and advice.

We'll keep creating interesting games, so we appreciate your support!
